subject: Ivega — marketplace activation map & evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@ivega.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Ivega — marketplace activation map & evaluation timeline

Alex — following up from our demo last week. I sketched a pragmatic activation map that ties together the AWS Private Offer route you preferred, a short evaluation window for your ML team, and the billing/procurement steps your finance team asked about. See the attached "Ivega_MAP_v1.pdf" for the visual flow; key points below.

1) 2-week technical evaluation (team-level):
   - Start: Apr 18 — access to a dedicated Redwood sandbox instance (private subnet option).
   - Goals: latency < 350ms for 512-token prompt, throughput >= 120 rps for batched inference, verified sample output coverage for 6 critical prompts.

2) Marketplace activation path (preferred):
   - Private Offer via AWS Marketplace (PO number path) — enables subscription billing through Marketplace and keeps procurement happy.
   - Fallback: Azure Private Offer if AWS Marketplace delays.

3) Procurement / billing checklist for finance:
   - Request from Ivega: PO + signed SOW (redlines expected).
   - Billing: prefer Marketplace invoicing; if legal requires, Redwood can produce monthly invoice to Ivega with standard remittance.

4) Security & compliance items (parallel work):
   - We shared SOC2 artifact package (see SOC2_evidence_stub.zip) and can support KMS/HSM integration and network diagrams for your security review.

5) Proposed timeline:
   - Apr 18–May 1: eval
   - May 2–10: procurement/contract finalization
   - May 11: onboarding & first production traffic (pilot)

Can you confirm: (a) procurement contact to receive the private offer, (b) any fixed billing constraints (net terms, invoicing via marketplace only), and (c) whether your security team needs a staged SOC2 review call next week?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call to walk through the MAP.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Ivega_MAP_v1.pdf, SOC2_evidence_stub.zip
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@ivega.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@ivega.com>, Juan Perez <juan.perez@ivega.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ivega — marketplace activation map & evaluation timeline

Tessa — thanks for the clear plan and the visual. High level: this aligns with our internal priorities. Quick notes: 

- Procurement contact is Priya Rao (cc'd). Please send the AWS Private Offer paperwork to her for an estimate and PO routing.
- Billing: our default is marketplace invoicing; however, our legal wants to review SOW for indemnities. Net30 is preferred.
- Security: Juan (cc'd) will coordinate the SOC2 artifacts review. He asked if Redwood can provide a short runbook of data flows for the sandbox (VPC peering / egress rules).

A few asks from our side before the eval: can you (1) include a short acceptance checklist we can attach to the PO, and (2) confirm whether the sandbox will persist logs for 90 days (we need logs for incident triage during the eval).

If we can get those items by Apr 14 we can start Apr 18 as planned.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Mercer
Director of AI Platforms, Ivega Systems
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@ivega.com>, Juan Perez <juan.perez@ivega.com>

Priya / Juan — looping you in. Priya, we'll prepare the AWS Private Offer packet and a concise acceptance checklist you can attach to the PO. Action items we will deliver by Apr 14: 

- Redwood: AWS Private Offer draft + quoted commitment (Ben will assemble line items).
- Redwood: Acceptance checklist (3 pass/fail items + sampling criteria) and sandbox runbook (network diagram, required ports, KMS notes).
- Redwood: Confirm sandbox logging retention = 90 days (we can enable this for the eval).

Laura — can you take point on the SOW redline timeline if legal pushes changes? Ideally we get a draft SOW back by May 3 so procurement can sign-off the week of May 6.

Priya — will you accept a Marketplace private offer flow (AWS) for billing, or do you need Redwood to issue invoices directly? Alex indicated marketplace is preferred; please confirm net terms (Net30/Net45).

Thanks — I'll attach the initial SOW draft and the MAP PDF after this note.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan

Hi Priya / Juan — Ben here. Quick confirmation from our side on the procurement and billing flows we can support: 

- AWS Private Offer: we will generate a Private Offer with the quoted SKU and a one-month starter commitment that maps to the eval discount structure. Once you accept the PO, AWS will handle monthly invoicing through the marketplace.
- If your procurement needs Redwood invoices directly instead of marketplace billing, we can accommodate that with standard Net30 terms and monthly invoicing — please confirm in your reply.
- SOW: attached draft is intentionally short (services + acceptance criteria). If legal sends redlines, Laura will triage and return within 3 business days.

Next steps I propose:
1) Priya confirms billing preference and net terms (reply by Apr 14)
2) Tessa sends Private Offer draft + acceptance checklist by Apr 14
3) Ivega accepts Private Offer and issues PO by May 3
4) We kick off sandbox access on May 6 (if procurement needs an extra week we can stretch to May 13)

Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow to finalize the PO packaging if helpful.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
